summary: Cursor IDE - Sensitive File Overwrite Bypass
details:
### Summary
A set of case-sensitive checks in the way Cursor IDE protects its sensitive files (i.e. */.cursor/mcp.json) allows attackers to modify the content of the files through prompt injection, thus achieving remote code execution.

### Impact
A prompt injection can now lead to full RCE through modifying sensitive files on case-insensitive fileystems

### Remediations
The checks were changed to be case insensitive

database_specific.source: GitHub repository advisory (cursor/cursor); not in OSV
